products.name: Aurora Smart Ambient LED Strip (5M)
products.shortDescription: App-controlled RGBIC ambient lighting strip with music synchronization.
products.description: The Aurora Smart Ambient LED Strip (5M) is engineered to deliver exceptional performance and reliability. Crafted from premium materials to exacting standards, it offers superior functionality, modern aesthetics, and intuitive usability suited for everyday lifestyle and professional demands.

products.name: ErgoPro Ultra-Mesh Ergonomic Desk Chair
products.shortDescription: High-performance breathable mesh ergonomic task chair with 4D armrests.
products.description: Engineered for all-day comfort and spine alignment. The ErgoPro chair features full Korean elastomeric breathable mesh, dynamic self-adjusting lumbar support, 4D multi-directional armrests, and a heavy-duty aluminum wheelbase tested up to 300 lbs.

products.name: SonicPulse Active Noise Cancelling Earbuds
products.description: Experience studio-grade acoustics with the SonicPulse Active Noise Cancelling Earbuds. Featuring active hybrid noise cancellation (up to -35dB), custom 10mm titanium drivers for deep bass, and dual beamforming microphones with AI wind reduction for crystal-clear calls. Includes IPX5 sweat resistance and up to 32 hours total playback with USB-C wireless charging case.

products.name: HyperCharge 65W GaN Dual-Port Travel Charger
products.shortDescription: Pocket-sized GaN III fast charger with USB-C and USB-A ports.
products.description: Engineered with next-generation Gallium Nitride (GaN III) semiconductors, the HyperCharge 65W GaN Dual-Port Travel Charger delivers ultra-efficient, high-speed power delivery in a compact pocket footprint. Dual-port architecture supports simultaneous laptop and smartphone charging with intelligent temperature monitoring and universal voltage compatibility (100-240V).

products.name: HydroFlow Insulated Stainless Steel Bottle (1L)
products.description: Durable double-wall 18/8 food-grade stainless steel flask keeps beverages cold for 24 hours or piping hot for 12 hours. Sweat-free powder coat finish with leak-proof spout lid.

products.name: Quantum Pro Mechanical Keyboard RGB
products.description: Built for discerning typists and gamers alike, the Quantum Pro Mechanical Keyboard RGB features an aerospace-grade aluminum top plate, hot-swappable PCB, and sound-dampening silicone gaskets. Enjoy per-key RGB backlighting with dynamic software customization, seamless Bluetooth 5.1/2.4GHz wireless connectivity, and pre-lubed mechanical switches.

products.name: AeroGlide Featherlight Trail Running Shoes
products.shortDescription: All-terrain lightweight trail runners with responsive carbon-plate cushioning.
products.description: Conquer tough terrain with the AeroGlide Trail Runners. Engineered with a rugged Vibram Megagrip lug outsole, water-resistant ripstop mesh upper, and high-rebound supercritical foam midsole for responsive propulsion across mud, gravel, and mountain trails.

products.name: Nordic Minimalist Solid Oak Coffee Table
products.shortDescription: Scandinavian handcrafted natural white oak living room table.
products.description: Meticulously crafted from FSC-certified solid white oak, the Nordic Minimalist Solid Oak Coffee Table embodies timeless Scandinavian simplicity and craftsmanship. Finished with a durable organic matte lacquer resistant to daily spills and UV fading. Clean chamfered edge profiles and reinforced mortise-and-tenon joinery ensure generational durability.
